📌

Hey Product Hunt 👋   
I'm Uri. Oscar and I are building Revix AI from Barcelona.

Why we built it: LLMs made us write code much faster, but we watched quality drop and incidents go up. Review is where that should get caught, and it usually doesn't, because most review comments don't know how your repo actually does things. So people stop reading them.

Revix starts by scanning your repo and generating its own pattern and architecture rules. You don't write a rulebook. It reviews every pull request against those rules and keeps learning as the repo changes. [...] Each comment names the rule behind it and is labeled by intent and severity, so you know why it's there and what to fix first. The number we care about is how many comments you act on, not how many we leave.

It works with GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket Cloud. It's free for public repos, with a 14 day trial and no card for private ones.

It's early and some comments will miss. Please be blunt: run it on a repo you know well and tell us which comment was useless and why. Oscar and I are here all day.
